queries: housing market days on market trend

findings.claim: Median U.S. days on market was 60 days in August 2026, up 3 days from July and flat year over year, per Realtor.com's August housing report.
findings.sourceTitle: Delistings Trend Below Last Year's Pace As Summer Comes to an End: Realtor.com August Housing Report

findings.claim: Active listings hit 1,140,035 in August 2026, up 3.6% year over year, while the median list price fell to $424,500, down 1.3% year over year.
findings.sourceTitle: Delistings Trend Below Last Year's Pace As Summer Comes to an End: Realtor.com August Housing Report

findings.claim: 20.4% of active listings carried a price reduction in August 2026, up 0.4 points from July, and contract signings were down 3.7% year over year.
findings.sourceTitle: Delistings Trend Below Last Year's Pace As Summer Comes to an End: Realtor.com August Housing Report

findings.claim: Sellers gave buyers concessions in 46.2% of U.S. home sales in the three months ending May 31, 2026, up from 43.1% a year earlier and the highest spring share since Redfin began tracking in 2019.
findings.sourceTitle: 46% of Home Sellers Gave Concessions to Buyers in May, the Highest Share on Record For That Month

findings.claim: Redfin counts roughly 47% more home sellers than buyers in the U.S. market, the imbalance driving record spring concession rates.
findings.sourceTitle: 46% of Home Sellers Gave Concessions to Buyers in May, the Highest Share on Record For That Month

findings.claim: Concession rates vary sharply by metro: 75.5% of Nashville sellers gave concessions in the three months ending May 2026 versus 2.9% in New York City.
findings.sourceTitle: 46% of Home Sellers Gave Concessions to Buyers in May, the Highest Share on Record For That Month

findings.claim: 29% of agents said staging their sellers' homes produced a 1% to 10% increase in the dollar value offered, per NAR's 2025 Profile of Home Staging.
findings.sourceTitle: NAR Report Reveals Home Staging Boosts Sale Prices and Reduces Time on Market

findings.claim: 83% of buyers' agents said staging made it easier for a buyer to envision the property as their future home, and 30% of sellers' agents saw a slight decrease in time on market while 19% saw a significant reduction.
findings.sourceTitle: NAR Report Reveals Home Staging Boosts Sale Prices and Reduces Time on Market

findings.claim: The living room is the room buyers most want staged (37%), followed by the primary bedroom (34%) and kitchen (23%); sellers' agents stage the living room 91% of the time.
findings.sourceTitle: NAR Report Reveals Home Staging Boosts Sale Prices and Reduces Time on Market

findings.claim: The median cost of a professional staging service is $1,500, versus $500 when the listing agent stages the home themselves.
findings.sourceTitle: NAR Report Reveals Home Staging Boosts Sale Prices and Reduces Time on Market

findings.claim: 100% of recent home buyers used the internet at some point in their home search, and 41% started the search online, per NAR data reported by Axios.
findings.sourceTitle: 100% of buyers now shop for homes online, new report says

findings.claim: NAR's 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers found 81% of buyers rated listing photos the most useful feature of their online home search.
findings.sourceTitle: NAR Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers, 2020-2025: Key Trends

findings.claim: First-time buyers fell to just 21% of purchasers, the lowest since records began in 1981, with a median age of 40; all-cash buyers stayed at an all-time-high 26%.
findings.sourceTitle: Top 10 Takeaways from NAR's 2025 Profile of Home Buyers and Sellers

findings.claim: AI virtual staging runs up to about $50 per photo, roughly a tenth of physical staging, and some listing databases now require agents to disclose when AI was used in listing photos.
findings.sourceTitle: Virtual Staging Can Help You Sell Your Home, but at What Cost?
